answer: Gold leaf trembles on the gilder cushion, lighter than a breath. Proof of gilder via leaf lay tally — a leaf the gilder lays only after 24 leaves lie smooth on the frame, each leaf laid by the gilder himself. quill sizes the frame and waits for the tack to turn just right. dawn lifts the leaf with the tip and lays it down without a wrinkle. nadir burnishes the gold with the agate till it shines like a mirror. To fake this proof a man needs 24 leaves laid without a tear, and the next one still cracks where the size ran dry.
